name: cc-live-compact
description: Compress finished tool results in place after each turn, with no model call, leaving the prefix before the cut unchanged. Asks for a compaction through /compact, so it works in headless (SDK) hosts too.

enabled.description: Cut finished tool results after each turn.
enabled.title: Cut finished tool results

minTokens.description: Context size, in tokens, above which a finished turn is cut.
minTokens.title: Cut threshold

keepRounds.description: Newest finished tool rounds kept verbatim.
keepRounds.title: Rounds kept verbatim

chunkMin.description: Smallest tool result, in tokens, worth replacing with a card.
chunkMin.title: Smallest result to cut

pointerTokens.description: Size, in tokens, at which one result becomes a pointer alone.
pointerTokens.title: Pointer threshold

bigGate.description: Hard ceiling, in tokens, past which the engine's own summarizer is left to work. Below it the mod stands down at 80% of the count the engine reports it summarizes at, or at 70% of the window when it reports none.
bigGate.title: Official compaction gate
